title: Juicy Grill Xinjiang Jumbo Shrimp Skewers
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly, Xinjiang-inspired dish from China, featuring jumbo shrimp on a robata grill. This recipe is a hangover cure due to its rich and savory flavors.

ingredients.name: Xinjiang Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Available at Asian grocery stores or online.

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine Xinjiang Spice Blend, brown sugar, soy sauce, rice vinegar, grated ginger, and diced green chili. Blend until smooth.
Pour the marinade into a large bowl and add the jumbo shrimp. Toss to coat and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the robata grill to high heat. Remove the shrimp from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Thread 3-4 shrimp onto each skewer, leaving a little space between each piece. Brush the olive oil onto the shrimp.
Season the shrimp with salt and black pepper. Place the skewers onto the robata grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Transfer the skewers to a plate and garnish with chopped scallions, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
For an added kick, serve with steamed rice or noodles.
For a spicy kick, serve with a side of diced jalapenos or sriracha sauce.
For a tangy kick, serve with a side of pickled ginger or kimchi.
For a sweet kick, serve with a side of honey or maple syrup.
For a smoky kick, serve with a side of smoked salmon or grilled pineapple.
For a savory kick, serve with a side of roasted vegetables or grilled tofu.
